nodes.title: LTX 2.5 / Image + text to video
widgets_values:
**Upload your image → describe the action → Run.**

Start with the defaults. **Upscale 2x** is on; turn it off for a draft. Your seed advances automatically. Double-click **Video Generation** to inspect the stages.

4K output (3840 × 2176) -> Set Base Width: 1920, Base Height: 1088, and Upscale 2x: On.
